messages:
maria: @paul_hw kicking off the Lithos joint bench — finalizing perf/W + steady-state throughput matrix. Can you confirm the telemetry export format and a 2-day slot for runs?
paul_hw: thanks @maria. we can do next Wed/Thu (2-day window). telemetry is NG telemetry v2 (gzip'd jsonl) to our S3 bucket. will share creds in DM. :+1:
cheng: adding kernel knobs we want to iterate on: `LIT_CUDA_KERNEL=fastpath`, `KV_CACHE_SHADER=on`, and try q8_0 vs q4f16. plan: 3 runs per config, 5 seeds.
elaine: for the marketplace listing we need two canonical configs (high-throughput, high-efficiency). acceptance criteria proposal:
- high-efficiency: >= 4.5 tokens/J at 512 seq, p95 latency < 140ms
- high-throughput: >= 2M tokens/s sustained over 60s tail with <=10% variance
maria: that looks good. add a regression check: no more than 3% quality delta on eval set A compared to baseline.
paul_hw: noted. we'll provision the Lithos proto nodes with telemetry agent 0.9.3. agent sends to `s3://lithos-partner-bench/redwood/` in `gzip+jsonl`. sample record:```{"ts": 1745007890, "device": "lithos-1", "power_w": 810.2, "tokens": 12345, "config": "q8_0|fastpath"}```
cheng: for automation I'll hook up a bench CI job. quick patch locally:```bash
# run one config
python bench/run.py --model redwood/lit-3b --seq 512 --config q8_0 --repeats 3 --out s3://lithos-partner-bench/redwood/raw/
```
bench-bot: CI job `partners/lithos-bench` queued (id: 2026-03-26-17). ETA: 36h for full sweep. :robot_face:
maria: timeline sync: prep + smoke (Tue), full sweep (Wed-Thu), initial writeup + joint blog draft Fri. who owns the writeup? @elaine?
elaine: happy to take the first draft. pls drop salient perf graphs (power vs tokens/s, latency CDF, quality delta) and we'll co-author with Lithos PR.
paul_hw: can do. i'll also capture kernel patch notes and exact kernel git SHAs used. expecting a few micro-patches to align scheduler.
cheng: quick ask on telemetry schema — include `mode` (throughput|efficiency), `seed`, and `run_id` at top level. will parse via `jq` pipeline.
maria: perfect. one more: let's define rollback triggers for Dedicated customers if we see >5% regressions after marketplace rollout. add to runbook.
paul_hw: agreed. locking in Wed/Thu. thanks everyone — i'll DM creds and add the ssh access list. :v:
elaine: added todo in the doc: upload links, creds, and draft outline. will ping when draft is live. :memo:
maria: thanks team. meeting check-in tomorrow 10:30 PT to finalize test matrix. :calendar:
